decision.explanation: The question asks for the medium of "The Private Secretary." Two distinct works share this title: a 1883 play by Charles Hawtrey (D1S1) and a 1935 British film (D2S1). Both are valid referents under the same name and describe different media. The R5_answers already include both 'play' and 'film,' supported by direct quotes from the respective documents. There is no evidence of conflicting interpretations between the two, and they are clearly separate works.
